description: Rogue Talents emphasize mobility, concealment, accuracy, opportunism, and exploiting enemy weaknesses.

talents.name: Martial Prowess
talents.effect: Functions identically to the Warrior's Martial Prowess. Choose one Weapon Attack different from that improved through generic Prowess. Each Rank improves either Attacks by 1 or Hit by 1 step, and improves one Skill.

talents.name: Extended Shot
talents.effect: Choose one non-Firearm ranged Weapon Attack. Increase its Range by 2" per Rank.

talents.name: Quick Draw
talents.effect: After choosing Assault Move, your next non-Heavy ranged Weapon Attack before the end of your next Assault activation gains Accurate 1. This does not permit an Attack during the same ordinary Assault activation as the Move; the bonus expires if unused.

talents.name: Tactical Feint
talents.effect: Choose an enemy Unit you are Engaged with. Roll Agility + Stealth. The enemy worsens its Evade by X steps against your next Weapon Attack targeting it this Turn, where X equals the number of successes.

talents.name: Smoke Bomb
talents.effect: Choose yourself or one friendly Unit within 2". The selected Unit gains Concealed until it Attacks, enters Engagement, or the Round ends.

talents.name: Mobile Assault
talents.effect: After making a Weapon Attack, move up to 1". This movement cannot leave Engagement or enter a new Engagement.

talents.name: Daring Entry
talents.effect: After successfully Charging and allocating at least one Momentum to additional distance, gain Accurate 1 on the first Melee Weapon Attack against the charged target that Round.

talents.name: Skirmisher
talents.effect: After making a ranged Weapon Attack, move up to 2". This movement cannot enter Engagement.

talents.name: Precise Fire
talents.effect: Choose one ranged Weapon Attack. That Attack gains Pinpoint.

talents.name: Covering Fire
talents.effect: When a friendly Unit within Short Range Disengages, make one eligible ranged Weapon Attack against an enemy it was Engaged with. Resolve the Attack normally.

talents.name: Slip Away
talents.effect: After completely Evading an Melee Attack, move up to 2". You may leave Engagement without becoming Withdrawn.

talents.name: Hamstring
talents.effect: After your Melee Weapon Attack deals Damage, the target suffers Slow 2 until the end of its next Movement activation.

talents.name: Retaliatory Step
talents.effect: After dealing Damage to an enemy in Engagement, move up to 1". This movement may leave Engagement without making you Withdrawn, but cannot enter Engagement with another enemy.

talents.name: Opportunist
talents.effect: When another friendly Unit deals Damage to an enemy you are Engaged with, make one Melee Weapon Attack against that enemy.

talents.name: Close-Quarters Shooter
talents.effect: When making a ranged Weapon Attack against an enemy you are Engaged with, gain Accurate 1. The target may still use Evade normally.
